convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to call CCandlePattern custom indicator which encapsulates all pattern detection logic; pattern logic is opaque without the .ex5/.mq5 of the custom indicator, requiring manual reverse-engineering of the pattern definitions

other_exits: Position is closed when opposite candle pattern signal is detected

custom_logic_notes: EA is a demonstration wrapper for the CCandlePattern custom indicator class. All candle pattern recognition logic (hammer, engulfing, doji, morning/evening star, etc.) is encapsulated inside CandlePatterns.mqh and accessed via iCustom(). The EA itself contains no explicit pattern-matching code; it simply queries the custom indicator for bullish/bearish pattern signals and trades accordingly. Reversal signal closes the existing position and optionally opens in the opposite direction. SL/TP are not set in the order; the EA relies purely on pattern-based signal reversal for exits. Digit adjustment is implied via standard _Point multiplication if SL/TP were added.
python_conversion_notes: The core challenge is that all pattern recognition lives inside CCandlePattern (CandlePatterns.mqh) which uses iCustom(). To convert to Python, the candle pattern detection logic must be reimplemented from scratch or the .mqh source must be obtained and manually translated. Each candle pattern (hammer, engulfing, morning star, etc.) will need explicit OHLC-based rule implementation in Python. The trade execution skeleton (new bar detection, position check, market order placement, signal-reversal close) is straightforward to replicate using a broker API. No SL/TP means risk is unbounded until opposing signal—consider adding default SL/TP in the Python version.
